context: User requests physical contact assessment of two field contact sheets.
prompt: You are the visual advisor; directly assess attached images yourself, do not delegate. Each image is 48 evenly sampled frames, 6 columns x 8 rows chronological, from Tesla owner car Sentry footage. Be careful about occlusion and missing frames. Output exactly one line each: <event>: VERDICT=contact|near_miss|quiet|unclear; ACTOR=<who/what or none>; CONFIDENCE=low|medium|high; NOTE=<up to 12 words>. Image 1 event 2026-09-10_18-35-56. Image 2 event 2026-09-10_18-37-09.
response:
2026-09-10_18-35-56: VERDICT=near_miss; ACTOR=person holding phone; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Approaches car; no physical contact visible in sampled frames.
